content.short: CoinFabrik is an R&D and security auditing company specializing in blockchain technologies and advisory.
content.description: Since 2014, CoinFabrik has delivered robust security solutions to safeguard blockchain platforms and smart contracts from vulnerabilities. Drawing on decade‑long expertise, CoinFabrik provides cost‑effective approaches that help optimize performance, reliability, and scalability across diverse ecosystems. Its flagship offering, Scout, is an open‑source static analyzer that enables developers to identify potential security threats early and to apply industry‑recognized best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
